record.notes: The TC260 Secretariat released it for public comment with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕119号 of 18 Sept 2026; comments were due by 2 Oct 2026. The draft itself is dated September 2026, is version v1.0-202609 and carries the number TC260-PG-2026NA. It covers software agentic AI systems built on large models, not agentic systems whose main function is controlling physical devices such as robots or autonomous vehicles. Its bibliography lists AI Safety Governance Framework 2.0 (CN-13) and TC260's practice guide on the security of deploying and using agents (CN-26).

verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Stored and read (tc260.org.cn, stored 14 Oct 2026 and unchanged when the archiver checked them on 18 Oct 2026): the draft PDF (31 pages), now the official_url, and the TC260 Secretariat's notice of 18 Sept 2026 calling for comments and attaching it, the previous official_url, now the secondary source. The PDF confirms the title, the draft status and version, the number TC260-PG-2026NA, the Secretariat as issuer, the month (2026年09月) and the contents; the summary follows the Chinese text. The notice announces the draft's release, so the day, 18 Sept 2026, and the comment deadline of 2 Oct 2026 are in the notes and date_published is 2026-09. TC260's home page, stored on 18 Oct 2026 in run 2026-10-18-recheck-east-asia-1, lists the latest notices of 13 Oct, 18 Sept and 15 Sept 2026; the newest notice on this guide is still the call for comments of 18 Sept, so no final version had been released by 18 Oct 2026. No English version was found.
